verdict.rationale: The evidence documents high-resolution scans, AI summaries, automatic labels and categorization, and unlimited cloud storage of digitized mail. It never mentions OCR or the ability to search the archive by sender, content, or date. AI summaries and labels are adjacent organizational features, not documented OCR or archive search, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an operator, scans are OCR'd and my mail archive is searchable by sender, content, and date
